event.title: Proposed default for Q-1
event.rationale: Sizing, caching and whether new infrastructure is needed

event.title: Proposed default for Q-2
event.rationale: Defines the acceptance test for performance work

event.title: Proposed default for Q-3
event.choice: Per-link totals, last click, daily counts
event.rationale: Determines the data model and the API

event.title: Proposed default for Q-4
event.choice: Best effort, up to 1 minute lag
event.rationale: Exact counting needs durable writes on the redirect path

event.title: Proposed default for Q-5
event.choice: Referrer host and agent family; 90 days
alternatives: Referrer host and agent family only

event.evidence: structurally backward compatible: 4 baseline operations kept with their success statuses, request and required response properties (5 total); types, formats and behaviour are not checked by this gate

reasons: api-contract-change: public API contract change (consumer impact) (api/openapi.yaml)

event.comment: Demonstration decision: meets the clarified answers without new infrastructure; the 2,000 rps / p99 < 50 ms target is measured by the load test, not assumed.

event.title: Recording durability (Q-1)
event.choice: Best effort: bounded ArrayBlockingQueue (10,000), batched inserts every second; full queue drops and counts; graceful shutdown flushes
event.rationale: No database work on the redirect path and bounded memory; losses are visible in metrics
alternatives: Synchronous insert (adds a write to every redirect)
Kafka (new infrastructure for an internal statistic)

event.title: Where clicks are recorded
event.choice: After a successful resolve in RedirectController
event.rationale: 404/410 are not clicks; the controller already has the headers

event.title: Click key
event.choice: Store the code, not the link id
event.rationale: Codes are never reused; recording needs no extra lookup

event.title: Privacy
event.choice: Referrer host and agent family only
event.rationale: Enough for campaign analysis; no personal data

event.title: Retention
event.choice: Purge clicks older than 90 days hourly; days window capped at 90
event.rationale: Bounded table growth; stats never promise data that was purged
